description: Upload a new file with text content to Google Drive.

content.description: Text content to upload as the file's body.

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type for the new file; defaults to text/plain when omitted.

name.description: Name for the new file in Google Drive.

parent_id.description: Optional ID of the parent folder to place the new file in; the file is placed at the Drive root when omitted.

name: upload_file
